title: Expose defaulted effective session in structured mutation receipts
outcome: Structured CLI consumers can recover and reuse a process-defaulted session without retaining stderr.
acceptance: A mutating shell word that defaulted its session includes the effective session id in its structured JSON receipt.
Hosted or explicitly injected attribution remains byte-for-byte unchanged and CLI/MCP parity coverage passes.

completion.summary: Exposed process-defaulted effective session ids on successful structured CLI mutation receipts while preserving every explicit, read, text, refusal, MCP, and host-core shape.
